title: feat(formula,plugin-email,lint)!: a mail template hole takes one formatter and a literal currency code, refused at authoring and at render
body:
Fixes #26673
Part of #26660 (item c, the silent USD; item b stays open on the card, see Acceptance notes)

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — the published skill (`skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md`, the `template` row) already spells a hole as one optional formatter, `{{ path | formatter[:arg] }}`; the refusals name both rules at every door, and `content/docs/automation/email-templates.mdx` is updated here.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:邮件模板占位符只允许一个格式化器,`currency` 的参数只能是三位大写 ISO 4217 字面代码;两条规则在 `os validate` / `os build` / `os lint` 与元数据发布门(`422 INVALID_METADATA`)拒收,渲染时同样拒收(`TEMPLATE_INVALID`),应用内模板方言共用同一判定。
- 为什么改:`{{ x | default:0 | number:2 }}` 会把 `0 | number:2` 原样发给收件人,`{{ x | currency:currency_code }}` 会静默按美元显示金额,所有门禁都放行(hotclm 实测)。
- 风险与回滚:收紧(BREAKING),写了链式格式化器或路径/小写币种参数的模板会被拒;本仓库零命中。已存储的旧模板在下次发布前发送会失败而不是发错。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/formula/src/template-engine.ts`(`judgeHoleFormatter` 与 `currency` 格式化器)、`packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-engine.ts`(渲染时抛 `TEMPLATE_INVALID`)、`packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.ts`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-email exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/template-hole-grammar.render.test.ts`(先 build formula),预期 10 passed:链式与路径参数都以 `TEMPLATE_INVALID` 拒收,`currency:EUR` 渲染为 €1,234.50。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

One hole grammar, one judgement, every reader:

- **`@objectstack/formula`**
  - `judgeHoleFormatter(hole, formatterPart, formatter, arg)` (in `template-engine.ts`, beside `FORMATTERS`) is the one judgement of a hole's formatter part, used by both template dialects. Two rules: **one formatter per hole** (a second `|` outside a closed quoted argument is refused), and **the `currency` argument is a literal ISO 4217 code in three capitals** (a path, a lowercase or an empty argument is refused). No argument still formats in USD.
  - The in-app dialect: `templateEngine.compile` / `evaluate` answer a `parse` error naming the hole and the rule, so `validateExpression` reports `invalid-template` at `os validate` and the publish gate.
  - The `currency` formatter no longer catches the `Intl` refusal and substitutes USD: a non-code argument throws a `RangeError` before the value is read.
  - The mail hole grammar now lives once, in `mail-hole-grammar.ts` (`mailHolePattern`, `parseMailHole`, `judgeMailHoleGrammar`). `judgeMailHtmlHoles` drops its copy and imports it; so does the renderer below. A chained hole is recognised as a hole even when its first formatter alone would not parse (`{{ x | upper | lower }}` used to be left on the page verbatim).
- **`@objectstack/lint`**: a new gating rule, `email-template-hole-grammar` (`validateEmailTemplateHoleGrammar`), judges `subject`, `bodyText` and `bodyHtml` of every template on all three commands and on the runtime publish surface for `email_template` writes, refused there with the existing `422 INVALID_METADATA`. The four CLI transcripts that print the rule count (54 to 55) are updated.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-email`**: the renderer parses with the shared grammar; a refused hole throws `TEMPLATE_INVALID`, and `resolveAndRenderTemplate` names the template and locale in front of it. It is reached only by a template stored before the rule existed, until its next publish. It is now the one way a render throws.
- **`@objectstack/service-messaging`** (patch round 1): the email and inbox channels' `classifyError` grade `TEMPLATE_INVALID` permanent, beside `TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND`, `TEMPLATE_INACTIVE`, `MISSING_VARIABLES` and `TEMPLATE_UNSUPPORTED`. A pre-rule stored template that fails this way now goes dead at once with the code on its delivery row, instead of spending its retry ladder. Patch changeset `26660-mail-hole-grammar-messaging.md` (`Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`).

**Landing outside the named files, and why.** The save-time verdict's producer is the authoring-rule registry in `packages/lint` (the `email_template` publish door is that registry's runtime surface), not `email-template-door.ts`, which is the closed `sys_email_template` row door and judges no holes. The door pin lives in `packages/metadata-protocol` (test only), beside the placement rule's.

**Same-day churn.** Both symptoms re-measured on `origin/main` `a485b5a3` through the surviving by-name render path, `EmailService.renderTemplate` (the module-level body renderer is retired from the entry). `currency:currency_code` with `eur` rendered `US$1,234.50` (zh-CN), `$1,234.50` (en-US), `1 234,50 $US` (fr-FR); the chained hole rendered `0 | number:2` for null and `71100` otherwise, in subject, text and html.

**Sweep (one pass, all trees: `packages`, `examples`, `skills`, `content`, `apps`, `ui`, `docs`).** Chained holes: zero hits (the one regex hit is a JSX `style` object). `currency:` arguments: all are uppercase literals (`EUR`, `USD`, one quoted `'USD'`), all still admitted. No in-repo template needed a change.

## Tests

- `packages/formula/src/template-hole-grammar.test.ts` (new, 24): both rules through `judgeHoleFormatter`, the in-app compile / evaluate / `validateExpression`, the formatter backstop, and the mail grammar's parse and per-face judge.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-email/src/template-hole-grammar.render.test.ts` (new, 10): `renderTemplate` and `sendTemplate` refuse both shapes in each face with `TEMPLATE_INVALID` naming template, locale, hole and rule; nothing is sent; one formatter, a quoted `|` and `currency:EUR` still render.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-email-template-hole-grammar.test.ts` (new, 15): the rule per face, the registry entry (gating, all commands, `email_template` runtime surface), each `os` command at `error`, the runtime gate.
- `packages/metadata-protocol/src/runtime-authoring-gate.email-template-writes.test.ts` (+2): each refusal at the publish door asserts `code` `INVALID_METADATA` + `status` 422 + the issue's rule and path, with a non-vacuous admit.

Ablated per channel (the word removed from the regex): each went red on exactly that pin, `expected 'retryable' to be 'permanent'`, and was restored to the HEAD blob.

## Acceptance notes

- **Remaining half of #26660 (item b): format an amount in the record's own currency.** Not built. Reading the code from the data (`currency:record.currency_code`, or a per-hole value the formatter knows the code of) widens the template grammar, which triage sent back to triage. Until then the refusal says to format the amount in the caller and pass the text.
- **`currency` with no argument still formats in USD.** Unchanged by these cards (a present non-code argument is what is refused). It is the same reader-sees-a-currency-nobody-chose shape for a record in another currency; noted for the item-b decision, not changed here.
- **The in-app template dialect narrows too.** The two rules are judged once for both dialects because the formatter is shared: a non-code `currency` argument can no longer render, so the in-app compile must refuse it rather than let `evaluate` throw. Same defect class, same file family; the in-app chain (`default:0 | number:2` printed `0 | number:2` there as well) is refused by the same function.
- **`TEMPLATE_INVALID` is a new render failure code.** The messaging email and inbox channels grade it permanent (patch round 1). The `IEmailService` contract's error lists in `packages/spec/src/contracts/email-service.ts` still name three codes; that documentation line is the spec lane's: filed by the seat as #26803.
- **Other formatter arguments are still unjudged** (`number:two` silently formats without fixed digits). Not measured at a door here; noted only.
- **Serial constraint.** `origin/main` merged at `0f3d068c`; #25805 (also on `packages/lint`) has not landed. It adds an authoring rule too, so whichever lands second moves the four transcript counts again (`check:docs-transcript-drift` names them).
